DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車をお探しですか。どちらの入口から入ったか覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for your bicycle? Do you remember which entrance you came in through?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝は川側の入口を使いましたが、今は駅側に出てしまって、自転車が見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝使った入口と現在いる入口の違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I used the riverside entrance this morning, but now I have come out on the station side and cannot find my bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the entrance you used this morning and the one where you are now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つの入口で見える列が違います。利用時の控えは残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Different rows are visible from the two entrances. Do you still have your parking slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙が控えだと思います。番号の最後が薄くて、三なのか八なのか読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えの末尾が三か八か判別できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I think this paper is the slip. The last digit is faint, and I cannot tell whether it is three or eight.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you cannot distinguish whether the slip's last digit is three or eight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一緒に見ましょう。自転車の色と、目印になるものも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us look together. Please also tell me the bicycle's color and any identifying features.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 車体は銀色で、前のかごに赤いひもを結んであります。鍵は私が持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色と赤いひもと鍵の所持を伝えて自転車の特定を助ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The frame is silver, and I tied a red cord to the front basket. I have the key.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Help identify the bicycle by giving its color, red cord and the fact that you have the key. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら川側の列から確認しましょう。出口へ進む前に、控えと自転車を照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us check the riverside rows first. Before heading to the exit, match your slip to the bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見つかったら、料金はどこで確認すればいいですか。朝は急いでいて表示を見ませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出庫前に料金をどこで確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Once I find it, where should I check the fee? I was in a hurry this morning and did not look at the sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where you can check the fee before taking the bicycle out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出庫の案内板を一緒に読めます。金額や支払い方法を確認してから、出庫の操作に進みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can read the exit information board together. Let us check the amount and payment method before proceeding with the exit operation.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず川側で赤いひもの自転車を探し、番号を確かめてから案内板を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 川側で探して番号を照合し案内板を見る順番を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I will look on the riverside for the bicycle with the red cord, check the number, and then read the information board.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the order: search on the riverside, match the number, then read the information board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では川側の入口までご案内します。自転車が見つかった後も、気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will show you to the riverside entrance. Take care on your way home after you find your bicycle too.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方を待っていらっしゃいますか。それとも見学の順路をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you waiting for someone, or are you looking for the viewing route?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が後から来ます。合流するまで少し時間があるので、短く見られる展示を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人を待つ間に短く見られる展示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend is coming later. There is a little time before we meet, so please tell me about an exhibit I can see briefly.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an exhibit you can see in a short time while waiting for your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの案内図では、入口の近くに城の模型があります。興味のある内容はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This map shows a castle model near the entrance. Is there anything you are interested in?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 建物の形に興味があります。模型で全体を見てから、実物を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 建物の形を模型と実物で比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am interested in the shape of buildings. I would like to see the whole thing in the model before looking at the real building.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to compare the building's shape in the model and the actual building. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 模型の説明から始めると形を比べやすいですね。友人にはどこで待ち合わせると伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Starting with the model's explanation makes it easier to compare the shapes. Where did you tell your friend to meet you?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ入口としか伝えていません。案内図にある模型前を待ち合わせ場所にしてもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曖昧な入口の約束を模型前へ具体化したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have only said the entrance so far. Could we use the area in front of the model on the map as our meeting point?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to make the vague entrance meeting arrangement more specific by meeting in front of the model. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路をふさがない位置を選びましょう。模型を見た後は、その横の待機場所で合流できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us choose a position that does not block the passage. After seeing the model, you can meet in the waiting area beside it.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人に場所を説明するため、模型の写真を撮りたいのですが、先に何を確かめればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人への説明用に撮影したいと述べて確認事項を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to photograph the model to explain the location to my friend. What should I check first?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to take a photo to explain the location to your friend, and ask what to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その展示の撮影表示を確認してください。表示が見つからなければ、担当者に尋ねてから撮りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the photography sign for that exhibit. If you cannot find one, ask the person in charge before taking a photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 撮影の表示を確認し、撮れない場合は案内図の目印を文章で友人に送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影表示を確かめ撮れなければ目印を文章で送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the photography sign. If photos are not allowed, I will send my friend a written description of the landmark on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the photography sign and send the landmark in writing if photography is not possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それなら合流しやすいですね。模型前で楽しくお待ちください。お二人そろったら、よい見学を。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: That should make meeting easier. Enjoy your wait in front of the model, and have a good visit once you are both here.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお肉をお包みしますね。お持ち帰りの袋はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will wrap this meat for you. Do you have a bag to take it home in?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 布の袋がありますが、中に本を入れています。肉の汁でぬれないように分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 布の袋に本があるため肉の汁から守りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a cloth bag, but it has books inside. I want to keep them separate so the meat juices do not wet the books.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have books in your cloth bag and want to protect them from meat juices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 肉は包みを分けてお渡しできます。何種類のお肉をまとめて持ち帰りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can give you separate packages of meat. How many kinds of meat will you take home together?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この豚肉と鶏肉の二つです。料理が違うので、どちらか分かるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 豚肉と鶏肉を判別できる包み方を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: These two: pork and chicken. They are for different dishes, so please make it clear which is which.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for packaging that lets you distinguish the pork and chicken. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 種類を書いた包みにします。布の袋に一緒に入れますか、それとも肉だけ別に持ちますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will label the packages with the meat types. Will you put them in the cloth bag together, or carry the meat separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 肉だけ別に持ちたいです。持ち手のある袋を付ける場合の金額も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 肉を別に持つ希望と持ち手付きの袋の金額を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to carry just the meat separately. Please also tell me the charge if I add a bag with handles.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to carry the meat separately and ask the price of a bag with handles. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋の種類と会計の内訳をこちらの表示で確認しましょう。お支払いはどの方法をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the bag types and itemized charges on this display. How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 現金で払います。袋を含めた合計を聞いてから、お金を出してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金払いを選び袋込みの合計を聞いてから払いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: In cash. May I hear the total including the bag before taking out my money?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose cash payment and say you want to hear the total including the bag before paying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: もちろんです。内訳を読み上げますので、品物と袋の内容が合っているかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. I will read out the breakdown, so please check that the items and bag match what you want.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 豚肉と鶏肉を分けた包みと、肉用の袋でお願いします。本は布の袋に残しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二種類の肉を分けて肉用の袋に入れ本を別に保つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Separate packages for the pork and chicken, and a bag for the meat, please. I will leave the books in the cloth bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the two meats will be separately wrapped in a meat bag and the books kept apart. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望の包み方で用意します。品物とおつりをお確かめのうえ、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will prepare your preferred packaging. Please check your items and change, and take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検索機の前でお困りでしたか。探している本の手がかりを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you having trouble at the search terminal? Please tell me any clues about the book you want.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 読書会で紹介された本ですが、題名を忘れました。著者の名前だけメモしてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 題名が不明で著者名のメモだけあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was introduced at a book club, but I forgot the title. I only have the author's name written down.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know the title and only have a note of the author's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 著者名で候補を探せます。小説でしたか、それとも別の種類の本でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can search for possible books by author. Was it a novel, or another kind of book?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 暮らしについて書いた随筆です。題名には季節を表す言葉があった気がします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 随筆で季節の言葉が題名にあったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a collection of essays about daily life. I think the title had a word referring to a season.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is an essay collection and you think a seasonal word was in the title. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 候補の題名を一緒に見て、内容紹介で確かめましょう。読みたい本が見つかったら借りる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us look at possible titles together and check their descriptions. Do you plan to borrow it if you find the book you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 借りるつもりです。ただ、この図書館を初めて利用するので、まだ利用カードを持っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 借りたいが初回利用でカードがないと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I plan to borrow it. But this is my first visit to this library, so I do not have a library card yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to borrow it but have no card because this is your first visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 貸出しの登録案内を確認できます。今日のところは、登録の相談と本探しのどちらから始めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check the borrowing registration guidance. Would you like to start with registration advice or finding the book today?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず候補を見つけたいです。登録がすぐできなかった場合、館内で読む場所も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 候補を先に探し登録できなければ館内で読む場所を知りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to find possible books first. If I cannot register immediately, I would also like to know where I can read inside the library.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to find possible books first and learn where to read inside if you cannot register. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本が見つかったら館内利用の案内もお見せします。読書会はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once we find the book, I will also show you the guidance for reading inside. When is your book club?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 来週です。今日は本を特定して、登録に必要なものを確認してから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 読書会の日程と本の特定と登録準備を今日済ませる方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Next week. Today I will identify the book and check what I need for registration before going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the book club schedule and your plan to identify the book and prepare for registration today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では著者名のメモを検索機へお持ちください。候補を一緒に探しましょう。読書会の後も、ぜひまたお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then bring your note of the author's name to the search terminal. Let us look for possible books together. Please visit again after your book club too.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 機械はこちらで止めました。いつもと違う音がしたそうですが、どこにいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: We have stopped the machine. I heard there was an unusual noise; where were you?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 切断台の横で材料を渡していました。木を送り始めた直後に、短い金属音がしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の位置と木を送り始めた直後の金属音を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was handing over material beside the cutting table. Just after we began feeding the wood, there was a brief metallic sound.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report your location and the metallic sound just after feeding the wood began. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 材料を渡す位置から聞こえたのですね。音の前に、木の状態で気づいたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you heard it from the material handover position. Before the noise, did you notice anything about the wood's condition?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 端に小さな割れ目が見えました。関係があるか分からず、まだ材料には触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 割れ目を見たが関係は不明で触っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I saw a small crack at the end. I do not know whether it is related, and I have not touched the material yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you saw a crack, do not know if it is related, and have not touched the material. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 触らずに知らせたのは適切です。その材料は私が確認します。次の材料を運ぶよう頼まれていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You were right to report it without touching it. I will check that material. Had you been asked to bring the next piece?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次の材料を運ぶ予定でした。でも今は運ぶのをやめています。機械の確認中は、どこで待てばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 材料運びを止めていると述べ安全に待つ場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was planning to bring the next piece, but I have stopped doing so now. Where should I wait while the machine is checked?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have stopped carrying material and ask where to wait safely. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路を空けて、打ち合わせ台で待ってください。再開の合図は私が出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep the passage clear and wait at the briefing table. I will give the signal to resume.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。音が消えていても、私の判断で次の木を渡さないということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 音が消えても自己判断で材料を渡さないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Even if the noise has stopped, I should not hand over the next piece of wood on my own judgment.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you will not hand over material on your own judgment even if the noise stops. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのとおりです。私に引き継ぐため、聞こえた時刻と使っていた材料もメモしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. To hand the information over to me, also note the time you heard it and the material being used.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時刻と材料の番号を書き、割れ目が見えた場所も添えます。打ち合わせ台でお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻と材料番号と割れ目の場所を記録して指定場所で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write the time and material number, adding where I saw the crack. I will wait at the briefing table.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record the time, material number and crack location, then wait at the specified place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認に役立ちます。まずはそちらへ移動してください。点検後に声をかけますので、また打ち合わせ台で。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: That will help the inspection. First, move over there. I will speak to you after checking; see you at the briefing table.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 包装台の準備はどうですか。記録を見てから始めてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: How is preparation of the packaging table going? Check the records before starting.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引継ぎ表の清掃確認欄が空いています。前の担当者は休憩中なので、終わっているか聞けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清掃欄が空白で前担当者にすぐ確認できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The cleaning confirmation field in the handover sheet is blank. The previous person is on break, so I cannot ask whether it is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the cleaning field is blank and you cannot immediately check with the previous person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 空欄のまま始めず、こちらに知らせてください。まだ製品を台に出していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not begin with the field blank; tell me. Have you put any products on the table yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 製品は容器の中に置いたままです。包装材だけ台の横へ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 製品は容器にあり包装材だけ運んだと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The products are still in their containers. I have brought only the packaging material beside the table.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report that the products are in containers and you brought only packaging material. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま待ってください。私が清掃の記録を確認します。包装材の種類は作業票と合わせましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Wait as you are. I will check the cleaning records. Have you matched the packaging type to the work order?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋の大きさは合っていますが、印字された商品名が作業票と違います。これも使わずに置いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋の大きさは合うが商品名が異なるため使わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The bag size matches, but the printed product name differs from the work order. I will leave these unused too.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the bag size matches but the product name differs, so you will not use them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の商品の袋ですね。混ざらないように私が引き取ります。今日の作業票の商品名を読んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Those bags are for another product. I will take them so they do not get mixed in. Could you read today's work-order product name?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 作業票には小分けの乾燥野菜とあります。正しい袋が来たら、表示をもう一度照合したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作業票の商品名を読み正しい袋を再照合したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The work order says individually portioned dried vegetables. Once the correct bags arrive, I would like to match the labeling again.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the product name on the work order and say you want to recheck the correct bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 正しい袋と清掃の確認がそろってから始めましょう。引継ぎ表には今の状況をどう残しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us begin only once both the correct bags and cleaning confirmation are ready. How will you record the current situation on the handover sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 清掃欄が未確認で、違う袋を見つけたため、包装を始めず責任者に報告したと書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 清掃未確認と袋違いを理由に開始せず報告した事実を残すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write that cleaning was unconfirmed and, after finding the wrong bags, I reported to the supervisor without starting packaging.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record that you did not start and reported because cleaning was unconfirmed and the bags were wrong. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その記録でお願いします。確認が済んだら呼びますので、待機場所へどうぞ。また包装台で合流しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please record that. I will call you when checks are complete, so go to the waiting area. Let us meet at the packaging table again.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの紙についてのご相談ですね。どちらの住所に届いたものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about the paper you have, correct? At which address did it arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越す前の住所に届いた不在連絡票です。旧居の管理人から渡されました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧居に届いた不在連絡票を管理人から受け取ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a missed-delivery notice sent to my previous address. My old building's manager gave it to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the manager gave you a missed-delivery notice sent to your old home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず連絡票に書かれた内容を確認しましょう。宛名はご本人のお名前ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let us check the notice's contents. Is it addressed to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の名前です。ただ、もう旧居には住んでいないので、新しい住所で受け取れるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛名が自分で現在の住所で受取りを相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It has my name. But I no longer live at the old address, so I would like advice on whether I can receive it at my new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is addressed to you and you want to discuss receipt at your current address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取りの扱いはその郵便物の情報を確認してからご案内します。今後の郵便についてもご相談がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain how receipt can be handled after checking that mail's details. Would you also like advice about future mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今後の郵便も相談したいです。転居の届出をしたつもりですが、受け付けられたか分かりません。申込みの控えは持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転居の届出の受付状況が不明で控えを持参したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, about future mail too. I thought I filed a change-of-address notification, but I do not know whether it was accepted. I brought the application receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the change-of-address acceptance status is unknown and you brought the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 控えと連絡票を分けて確認しましょう。今回の受取りと、今後の郵便の届出は別の確認になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the receipt and delivery notice separately. Receiving this item and the notification for future mail are separate checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、先に今回の郵便物を確認してください。控えはその後に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回の郵便物を先に確認し申込み控えを後で見てほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then please check this mail first. Could you look at the application receipt afterward?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check this mail first and look at the application receipt afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順番で伺います。差出人にも住所の変更を伝えたか、思い出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will follow that order. Can you remember whether you also told the sender your address changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ連絡していません。今日の相談が終わったら差出人に新住所を伝え、ほかの送付元も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未連絡の差出人とほかの送付元へ新住所を知らせる方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not contacted them yet. After today's consultation, I will tell the sender my new address and check other senders too.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State your plan to inform the uncontacted sender and other senders of your new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では連絡票をこちらへお願いします。受取り方法を確認してから控えを拝見します。相談が済みましたら、忘れ物のないようにお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-IMABARI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please give me the delivery notice. We will check how to receive the mail before looking at the receipt. After our consultation, please make sure you leave nothing behind when going home.

DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作業台に材料を置きましたね。加工に入る前に、図面の番号を読み合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have put the material on the worktable. Before processing it, let us read out the drawing number together.

DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 作業票には三番とありますが、手元の図面は二番です。このまま始めてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 作業票と手元の図面の番号が違うことを示し、開始してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: The work order says three, but the drawing I have is two. I am unsure whether I may start as it is.
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the different work-order and drawing numbers and ask whether to begin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号が違うので、まだ始めないでください。図面を渡したときに、ほかの説明はありましたか。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-03.translation: The numbers differ, so do not start yet. Was there any other explanation when you received the drawing?

DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 穴の位置を変更したと聞きました。新しい図面を受け取った覚えはありません。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 穴の位置の変更を聞いたが改訂図面を受け取っていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard the hole position had changed. I do not remember receiving a new drawing.
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you heard the hole position changed but have not received a revised drawing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、私が担当者に改訂版を確認します。その間に材料へ印を付ける作業も止めておいてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I will check the revision with the person responsible. Please also hold off marking the material in the meantime.

DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 印付けも待ちます。確認を待つ間、材料の数だけ数えてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 印付けを止めると答え、材料の数量確認だけ行えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait to mark it too. While waiting for confirmation, may I just count the materials?
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Agree to stop marking and ask whether you can just check material quantities. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 数を数えるところまではお願いします。機械の操作は、指導担当が来てから一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do count them. We will check machine operation together after the instructor arrives.

DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その順序で進めます。図面がそろっても、一人では機械を動かさず、指導担当を呼びます。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 図面がそろっても単独で機械を動かさず指導担当を呼ぶと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will follow that order. Even once I have the drawings, I will call the instructor rather than operate the machine alone.
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that even with the drawings ready, you will call the instructor and not run the machine alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでお願いします。数え終わったら、作業票の数量と違いがないか私に知らせてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. When you finish counting, tell me whether the quantity differs from the work order.

DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に数量を照合し、違いがあれば報告します。図面の確認が済むまで加工は保留します。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 数量を照合して相違を報告し、図面確認までは加工を保留すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I will match the quantity and report any difference. I will put processing on hold until the drawing is confirmed.
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will match quantities, report differences and hold off processing until the drawing is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認が取れたらこちらから声を掛けます。まずは数量の照合をお願いします。それでは、また作業台でお会いしましょう。
DLG-SC-EHM-NIIHAMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will speak to you once it is confirmed. First, please check the quantities. See you again at the worktable.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付用の箱を運ぶ方ですね。いま中央の通路で練習が始まったので、出発を少し待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are bringing the boxes for reception, correct? Practice has just begun in the central passage, so wait a little before setting off.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口に箱を三つ置いてあります。練習している人の間を通らずに運べる道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱が三つあることを伝え、練習中の人を避けられる搬入経路を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are three boxes at the entrance. Is there a route to carry them without going between the people practicing?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say there are three boxes and ask for a delivery route avoiding people practicing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 建物の横を回れますが、段差があります。箱の中身は割れやすい物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can go around the side of the building, but there is a change in level. Are the contents fragile?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙の名札と布だけです。ただ、一番大きい箱は持つと前が見えにくくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中身は紙と布だが大きい箱を持つと前が見えにくいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only paper name tags and cloth. But when I carry the largest box, it is hard to see ahead.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the contents are paper and cloth, but the large box obscures your forward view when carried. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら大きい箱は二人で運びましょう。私はもう一人呼ぶので、小さい箱から移せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us carry the large box with two people. I will call someone else; can you move the small boxes first?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい箱を先に運びます。横の道を進んだ後、受付のどちら側に置けばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小さい箱を先に運ぶと答え、受付に着いてから置く側を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will carry the small boxes first. After taking the side route, which side of reception should I put them on?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Agree to move the small boxes first and ask which side to place them on at reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付の裏にある青い布の上です。来場者が通る側には置かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: On the blue cloth behind reception. Do not put them on the side visitors walk through.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青い布の上に置きます。箱を積まずに並べたいのですが、場所は足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青い布の上に置くことを確認し、積まずに並べる余地を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put them on the blue cloth. I would like to line them up without stacking them; is there enough space?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm placement on the blue cloth and ask whether there is room to line them up without stacking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 横に並べて大丈夫です。名札の箱を手前にすると、受付係が取り出しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Side by side is fine. Putting the name-tag box at the front makes it easier for reception staff to take them out.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名札を手前にして小さい箱を並べ、その後で大きい箱を二人で運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名札を手前に置き、大きい箱は二人で運ぶ順番を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will line up the small boxes with the name tags at the front, then carry the large box with another person.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the order: place the name tags at the front, then carry the large box with two people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、私は手伝う人を連れて入口へ行きます。通路の様子を見ながらお願いします。それでは、入口でまた。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will bring a helper to the entrance. Please watch the passage conditions as you go. See you at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの装置に興味がおありですか。説明を読み終えてから、動く様子をご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you interested in this device? After reading the explanation, you can watch it move.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あとで友人に説明したいので、動くところを動画に撮ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人に説明する目的を示して動作の動画を撮れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to explain it to a friend later. May I film it moving?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your purpose of explaining to a friend and ask whether you may film the operation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用展示では動画の撮影はご遠慮いただいています。図のメモなら取れますが、何を伝えたいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Video recording is not allowed at this practice exhibit. You can make diagram notes, but what would you like to explain?

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 歯車が二つあるのに、片方を回すと反対向きに動く理由を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二つの歯車が反対向きに動く理由を記録したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to explain why, with two gears, turning one makes the other move in the opposite direction.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to record why the two gears move in opposite directions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: かみ合う部分を見ると方向がわかります。写真より、二つの円と矢印を描くと説明しやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can see the direction by watching where they mesh. Drawing two circles and arrows will make it easier to explain than a photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 丸を二つ描いて矢印を付けます。装置をもう一度動かして確かめられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 円と矢印で記録すると答え、装置の動きを再び見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will draw two circles with arrows. Could I watch the device operate again to check?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will record circles and arrows, and ask to watch the device move again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、次の方が来る前にもう一度ご覧ください。動かすのは係員ですので、手は台の外でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please watch once more before the next person arrives. Staff operate it, so keep your hands outside the table.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手を出さずに見ます。説明文の言葉が難しいので、歯がかみ合うという部分を短く言い換えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手を出さないと確認し、かみ合う部分の説明を短くしてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will watch without reaching in. The explanation's wording is difficult, so could you briefly rephrase the part about the teeth meshing?
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you will not reach in and ask for a shorter explanation of the meshing part. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一方の歯がもう一方の歯を押す、ということです。その押す方向を矢印で残すとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: It means one gear's teeth push the other gear's teeth. It would help to draw arrows showing that pushing direction.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 押す方向を図に書き、動画の代わりにその図で友人に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 押す方向を図に残し動画に代えて友人への説明に使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will draw the pushing direction in my diagram and use it instead of a video to explain to my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record the pushing direction in a diagram and use it instead of video to explain to your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 図ができたら、隣の展示でも回る方向を比べてみてください。見学を楽しんでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EHM-NIIHAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once your diagram is ready, try comparing the turning direction at the neighboring exhibit too. Enjoy your visit.
